notes: SEED SKELETON, not a verbatim copy. Unlike baseline-target (a byte-identical copy of an existing soul-lite), the optimizer's flowcharts do not exist anywhere yet, so the three files here are STRUCTURAL SCAFFOLDS authored from IMPLEMENTATION.md §2.1/2.3/2.4: real block graph (blocks, edges, args, sub-command calls, output_schema, the L2->L3 gate/fan-out topology) with documented-PLACEHOLDER block bodies ('echo TODO(phaseN): ...'). They are NOT wired to gaia-testbench and NOT runnable/tested. Fleshing out + wiring + testing is Phase 1 (mutate-config, evaluate-config, eval-case, judge) and Phase 2 (orchestrator, sample-config, run-experiment) — the TODO's own 'Author X.json' cards.

SCOPE = exactly the three flowcharts named in the Phase-0 card (orchestrator / mutate-config / evaluate-config). The sub-flowcharts they call — sample-config + run-experiment (from orchestrator), eval-case (from evaluate-config), judge (from eval-case) — are separate Phase-1/2 deliverables and are intentionally NOT in this seed; those command_name/spawn references dangle until their bundles are authored and added here.

main_model = null: the seed flowcharts do not pin a main-session model (the engine lets only spawn blocks set model — PLAN.md App. B; walker.py:570/blocks.py:106), so the orchestrator agent inherits the process default at runtime (this box: AXI_MODEL=opus, remapped to the local Qwen shim). Recorded null rather than fabricating an authored id. Under Phase-4 recursion the optimizer's main_model becomes a real mutation knob.
spawn_block_models = {}: the seed spawn blocks (run-experiment in orchestrator; eval-case L2/L3 in evaluate-config) do not pin models yet. Phase 1/2 authoring sets and tunes them.

kb/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md is a verbatim copy of prompts/SOUL.md @ fe7a248 (cmp-verified byte-identical to both prompts/SOUL.md and baseline-target/kb/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md). This is the orchestrator agent's infrastructure system prompt (PLAN.md §2c: 'SOUL + secretary personas', fixed during normal target search — never loaded into a candidate eval bot). It carries the same line-115 '%an'/'%ae' literal that trips the known soul_md.py:57 `content % {...}` TypeError (finding #1). Under Phase-4 recursion this prompt can itself become a mutation knob.

The optimizer's secretary personas (idea-secretary, dataset-secretary) live in extensions/autoresearch/ and are part of the optimizer's infra, but they are Phase-2/3 deliverables and do not exist yet — extensions = [].

The evaluate-config WIRE step's placeholder already records that Phase-1 must remap recorded Anthropic ids -> the served model.

VALIDATION (evidence, can-fail): all three flowcharts load via the engine's own flowcoder_flowchart.io.load_command() and pass flowcoder_flowchart.validation.validate() with 0 errors; a negative control (a deliberately-broken flowchart) is confirmed to fail validation, so the green result is meaningful. score.json shape is identical to baseline-target/score.json (n_evals:0).
